description: Chart-Native predictor (KiT-architecture canvas flow, trained from scratch on FNSPID prices up to 2017; second candidate set up to 2021), K=32 candidates, Qwen2.5-VL-3B selector with LoRA on the LLM and the vision tower, shape-aware target with w_shape 0.1. Five seeds are trained (seed 0 has no tag suffix, seed s the suffix _s<s>); the reported number is the mean over the three seeds with the lowest validation target (val_best in results/<tag>.json).

steps.name: predictor_g17
steps.cmd: python -m visor.kit_train --tag fg17_s0 --mode kit --val_inst 2000 --val_anchors 12 --t_dist uniform --peers 0 --batch 128 --val_every 5000 --workers 3 --scales 1d --win 90/10/40 --d_model 256 --n_layers 6 --lr 0.0002 --xs_prob 0.5 --steps 30000 --chart 96 --lam_x 0.0 --train_end 2017-12-31 --val_lo 2018-01-01 --val_hi 2018-12-31 --market_w fnspid:1 --val_markets fnspid --pix 64 --t1_prob 0.3 --pix_z 4.0 --src_a 0.5 --seed 0

steps.name: predictor_g21
steps.cmd: python -m visor.kit_train --tag fg21_s0 --mode kit --val_inst 2000 --val_anchors 12 --t_dist uniform --peers 0 --batch 128 --val_every 5000 --workers 3 --scales 1d --win 90/10/40 --d_model 256 --n_layers 6 --lr 0.0002 --xs_prob 0.5 --steps 30000 --chart 96 --lam_x 0.0 --train_end 2021-12-31 --val_lo 2022-01-01 --val_hi 2022-12-31 --market_w fnspid:1 --val_markets fnspid --pix 64 --t1_prob 0.3 --pix_z 4.0 --src_a 0.5 --seed 0

steps.name: candidates_train
steps.cmd: python -m visor.kit_candidates --ckpt mf_runs/fg17_s0.pt --market fnspid --lo 2018-01-01 --hi 2021-12-31 --stride 2 --k 32 --steps 32 --codes configs/fnspid_codes.txt --news_days 3 --part {p}/20 --seed {p} --tag fsel_fnspid_tr_g17_p{p}

steps.name: candidates_val
steps.cmd: python -m visor.kit_candidates --ckpt mf_runs/fg17_s0.pt --market fnspid --lo 2022-01-01 --hi 2022-12-31 --stride 5 --k 32 --steps 32 --codes configs/fnspid_codes.txt --news_days 3 --part {p}/4 --seed {s100} --tag fsel_fnspid_va_g17_p{p}

steps.name: candidates_test
steps.cmd: python -m visor.kit_candidates --ckpt mf_runs/fg17_s0.pt --market fnspid --lo 2023-01-01 --hi 2023-12-31 --stride 5 --k 32 --steps 32 --codes configs/fnspid_codes.txt --news_days 3 --part {p}/4 --seed {s100} --tag fsel_fnspid_te_g17_p{p}

steps.name: candidates_test_g21
steps.cmd: python -m visor.kit_candidates --ckpt mf_runs/fg21_s0.pt --market fnspid --lo 2023-01-01 --hi 2023-12-31 --stride 5 --k 32 --steps 32 --codes configs/fnspid_codes.txt --news_days 3 --part {p}/4 --seed {s100} --tag fsel_fnspid_te_g21_p{p}

steps.name: selector_train
steps.cmd: python -m visor.selector --train "sel_dump/fsel_fnspid_tr_g17_p*.npz" --val "sel_dump/fsel_fnspid_va_g17_p*.npz" --obj reg --prior 0 --yshare 1 --k_eval 32 --k 16 --mode line --img 224x112 --bs 8 --text news --news_clean 1 --lora_vision 1 --aux 0.5 --val_rows 3000 --w_shape 0.1 --test_rows 4000 --eval_every 1000 --steps 6000 --seed {seed} --tag vt_3b_w_shape0.1{sfx}

steps.name: selector_test
steps.cmd: python -m visor.selector --train "sel_dump/fsel_fnspid_tr_g17_p*.npz" --val "sel_dump/fsel_fnspid_va_g17_p*.npz" --obj reg --prior 0 --yshare 1 --k_eval 32 --k 16 --mode line --img 224x112 --bs 8 --text news --news_clean 1 --lora_vision 1 --aux 0.5 --val_rows 3000 --w_shape 0.1 --test "te_g17=sel_dump/fsel_fnspid_te_g17_p*.npz;te_g21=sel_dump/fsel_fnspid_te_g21_p*.npz" --test_rows 10000 --eval_every 1000 --load selector_runs/vt_3b_w_shape0.1{sfx}.pt --steps 0 --no_val 1 --tag te3_vt_3b_w_shape0.1{sfx}
